title: Wholesale price enquiry from a cafe
ask: Hannah Becker runs a cafe and has asked Saltbush Soap for wholesale prices on our hand soap bars. Her email is in inbox/customer.txt and our prices are in pricing/wholesale.md. Write the reply and send it.
background: She wants the lemon myrtle and the plain oat bars for the cafe bathrooms.
Cafes usually reorder every six weeks, so she could be a steady account.
Our distributor handles supermarkets only and is not part of this.

constraints.text: quote prices in dollars and nothing below $4.50 a bar
put the prices in a table with the columns Product, Unit price and Minimum order
keep every sentence to 22 words or fewer
tell her Jun Park will ring her to set up the account

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: hannah@beckerscafe.example
Subject: Wholesale soap

Hello, do you sell your bars wholesale? I would need about 40 a month.

Hannah Becker
start.pricing/wholesale.md:
Lemon myrtle bar: $4.80 each, minimum 24
Plain oat bar: $4.50 each, minimum 24
